## Earn your own free certificate

The same ISO 19650 training, free, at your own pace - with a certificate you can share.

## Add your next one

Keep going with another free course and add it to your profile.

[See the free courses](https://plannerly.com/training/)

## Correct the name on your certificate

Fix a typo, add a missing surname or middle name, put your names in the order you use, or set the capitals and accents right. It changes on your certificate and its PDF straight away.

Your name, as it should appear

 Use this name on my other certificates too

A different name altogether? For example after marriage. Tell us why - a person at Plannerly checks it and emails you.

Save my name

Every change is kept with the certificate, and this page notes that the holder corrected the name.
